name: publicala
description: Public Claude Code plugins by Publica.la.

plugins.name: feed-claude-md-files
plugins.description: Surfaces recurring patterns in commits and corrections, proposes them as new CLAUDE.md rules.

plugins.name: bake-claude-md-files
plugins.description: Converts CLAUDE.md rules into automated checks, freeing up agent context.

plugins.name: audit-claude-md-files
plugins.description: Prunes CLAUDE.md files down to what a session cannot derive on its own, with every cut backed by evidence.

plugins.name: split-claude-md-files
plugins.description: Moves CLAUDE.md rules to the load scope of the sessions they govern.
